versions.subject: feat: add new rules related to coldsteel
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - ' -k msupdate'
        - ' -k msupdate2'
        - ' -k alg'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\svchost.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -k msupdate", "* -k msupdate2", "* -k alg")
